issues: The source is a specimen form of Unit Certificate: the number, CUSIP, holder name, issue date and officer signatures are blank or facsimile.

The warrant covers one half (1/2) of one ordinary share at $11.50 per whole share, subject to adjustment as described in the Prospectus; the value keeps the plain-dollar exercise amount, its per-whole-share basis and the adjustment reference remain in the evidence. No per-half-share arithmetic was performed.
Par value $.0001 per share belongs to the ordinary share component, not to the exercise price.
supplementary.notes: Units are not separately transferable before the ninetieth day after the Prospectus; not labelled because no assigned field covers transferability.
